Resolves #19084

`TreeStoreValueBanding` now registers its test class once per worker process, at module scope, as 88 other unit specs do. It used to register in `beforeAll`, and a worker runs that hook again for a second group of the describe, where `unitTestMode` refuses a second class on the taken namespace. That was this arm's intermittent: CI's "1 flaky / 4259 passed" on 2026-09-19, and 1 flaky in 150 on the #19039 instrument's first hosted probe.

Evidence: L2 (the unit tier, locally, with repeats and a mutation control) → L2 required (a test-isolation defect in one spec).

Micro-review eligible: test-only — one spec's class registration moves from a hook to module scope; no production, fixture or config change.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1: 0 failed under repeats | `npm run test-unit -- …/TreeStoreValueBanding.spec.mjs --repeat-each=50 --workers=4 --retries=0` → **150 passed** (base `526b65e0ee`: **3 failed**, all `Namespace collision in unitTestMode`). |
| AC-2: mutation restores the collision | Registration moved back into `beforeAll`, same command → **2 failed / 148 passed**, both the collision. File restored. |
| AC-3: assertions unchanged | The three tests' bodies are untouched. The diff moves the class and its registration, and removes two lines of trailing whitespace the whitespace hook flagged. |

## Deltas from ticket

- The ticket said "85 files at module scope". The measured count is 88. 20 more register inside a `describe` callback, which also runs at collection time, and 31 inside tests or hooks; only this one used `beforeAll`.
- A repeat-only artifact was ruled out: `PipelinePush`, which registers inside a test body, passes 10/10 under `--repeat-each=10 --workers=1`. So repeats get fresh processes, and the collision needs `beforeAll` to run twice in one process.

## Test Evidence

- `test/playwright/unit/data/`: 141 passed.
- Base repro (3/150), fix (150/150), mutation (2/150). All three used `--repeat-each=50 --workers=4 --retries=0`.
